name: Phoenix (Shaman Spirit)
body:
A shaman who selects the phoenix spirit has flame-red eyes or hair, dancing in a hot draft, and a deep, melodic voice.

When she calls upon one of this spirit’s abilities, a ghostly winged figure formed of flames appears to surround her.

Spirit Magic Spells: touch of combustion (2th), spontaneous immolation (4th), trial by fire (6th), healing flame (8th), cleansing fire (10th), resurrection (12th), fire storm (14th), incendiary cloud (16th), fiery body (18th)

Hexes: A shaman who chooses the phoenix spirit can select from the following hexes.

Burning Magic (Su)

Whenever a creature fails a saving throw and takes fire damage from one of the shaman’s spells, it catches on fire. This fire deals 1 point of fire damage per spell level at the beginning of the burning creature’s turn. The fire lasts for 1d4 rounds, but it can be extinguished as a move action if the creature succeeds at a Reflex save (using the spell’s DC). Dousing the creature with water as a standard action grants a +2 bonus on this save, while immersing the creature in water automatically extinguishes the fire. Spells that do not grant a save do not cause a creature to catch on fire.

Destruction and Renewal (Ex)

The shaman gains Elemental Spell (fire) as a bonus feat. At 5th level, she gains Glorious Heat as a bonus spell. At 10th level, the shaman gains Burning Spell (fire only) as a bonus feat. The shaman doesn’t need to meet the prerequisites of these feats.

Firebird Aura (Su)

The shaman causes a creature within 30 feet to gain a bird-shaped flaming aura. Though this doesn’t harm the creature, it does cause the creature to emit light like a torch, preventing it from gaining any benefit from concealment or invisibility. The target also takes a –2 penalty on saving throws against death effects and spells or effects that deal negative energy damage. The firebird aura lasts for a number of rounds equal to the shaman’s level. A successful Will saving throw negates this effect.

Whether or not the save is successful, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Phoenix Senses (Ex)

The eyes of a phoenix see beyond the limits of mortal sight. The shaman gains either darkvision with a range of 60 feet or low-light vision. At 5th level, the shaman can select darkvision with a range of 60 feet or low-light vision if she does not yet have both, or she can add 30 feet to the range of her darkvision. At 11th level, the shaman gains a +4 bonus on Perception checks. At 15th level, this bonus increases to +8.

Sunfire Magic (Su)

The shaman can add a number of spells with the fire or light descriptors from any spell list equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1) to her spell list.

To cast these spells she must have a Charisma score equal to at least 10 + the spell’s level, but the saving throw DCs of these spells are always based on her Wisdom. When she casts these spells, they are always treated as divine. Each time the shaman gains a level after taking this hex, she can choose to replace one of these spells for a new one.

Spirit Animal: The shaman’s spirit animal has eyes or fur that seem on fire, and leaves burning prints when walking.

The animal gains the fiery creature template.

Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the phoenix spirit as her spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability.

Rejuvenating Touch (Su)

The shaman’s touch brings living creatures back to their inexperienced youth. As a melee touch attack, the shaman can deal 1 point of Wisdom damage for every two shaman levels she possesses (minimum 1) to living creatures. Alternatively, she can use this power to counter and dispel magical aging effects, such as sands of timeum. The shaman can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day for every five shaman levels she possesses.

Greater Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the phoenix spirit as her spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability upon having access to the greater version of that spirit.

Sun Dance (Su)

Once per day, the shaman can dance wildly for 10 minutes, entering a trance while enacting with her movements the mote of the sun. The sun dance must be uninterrupted and the shaman can take no other actions while dancing. When the shaman comes out of this trance, she has gained mystical insight into the future. This functions as a divination spell with 90% effectiveness. The shaman can use this ability an additional time per day at 12th, 16th, and 20th levels.

True Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the phoenix spirit as her spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability upon having access to the true version of that spirit.

Wings of the Phoenix (Su)

As a swift action, the shaman can manifest a pair of fiery wings that grant her a fly speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability. She can use these wings for 1 minute per day per shaman level she possesses. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1 minute increments.

Manifestation: Upon achieving 20th level, the shaman becomes one with the spirit of legendary phoenix. She receives a bonus on all saving throws equal to her Wisdom modifier. She becomes immune to death effects, fire and negative energy, and can use her wings of fire power indefinitely. Should the shaman die, she is reborn 3 days later as a resplendent infant that matures over the course of 7 days (treat as the reincarnate spell).
